sharedContent.title: Empowering Cambodian Girls
sharedContent.description: In rural Cambodia, education transforms lives. When you empower a Cambodian girl, you transform an entire community.

news.name: Sat Marany
news.description: Sat Marany, a 22-year-old from Banteay Meanchey Province, overcame significant challenges, including her parents working abroad since Grade 7. A recipient of the CATALYST Scholarship, she graduated with distinction from the Royal University of Phnom Penh in 2024, earning a Physics degree with a perfect GPA of 4.00 in her final year Currently, Marany works part-time at ISF International School and offers private tutoring, earning approximately $600 per month. She also volunteers at her university's Optoelectronics & Advanced Materials Laboratory and participated in the Asian Network School and Workshop on Complex Condensed Matter Systems 2024 in Thailand, broadening her scientific knowledge and network.

news.name: Supporting 100 Children in Prey Nup
news.description: On March 16, 2025, Lotus Outreach Cambodia, in collaboration with Let Us Create Futures and local authorities, successfully hosted its 6th Giving Back Event in Prey Nup District, Preah Sihanouk Province. This annual initiative, driven by the leadership of CATALYST students and alumni, is dedicated to fostering a culture of community service among young women. The event aimed to uplift children in need through the distribution of essential school materials, food, and hygiene products. It also empowered students to develop leadership, teamwork, and advocacy skills while creating a joyful and educational experience for the children.
